name: vanilla-plus-arsenal
title: Vanilla+ Arsenal
author: deadrat22
description: A curation and balance layer over standalone turret mods for vanilla+ Space Age games: the turret variety of a K2SO Arsenal stack without the modpack. All parents are optional; the mod adapts to whichever are installed. v0.1 is a skeleton: it detects the installed parents and logs the roster, with balance modules to follow.
